meaning.note: Read the complete original Japanese and English articles, researched primary references, revised both full bodies, then independently reread the complete corrected source and translation. Matched cookie transport versus JWT format; session consistency and theft; JWS/MAC/JWE and key roles; cryptographic verification versus claims and authorization; generic optional claims versus application requirements; individual versus key revocation and cached propagation; access versus refresh lifecycle; browser storage/XSS/CSRF; public-client refresh protection; and OAuth versus OIDC roles. Checked all three diagram labels and directions, including separating issuer, API and authorization server.

terminology.note: Used claims, issuer, audience, authorization grant, bearer token, MAC/shared secret versus public/private key, local validation, revocation, introspection, sender-constrained, rotation and reuse consistently. Corrected the original English standard of treating Cookie as the opposite of JWT, signing as always a server-secret-key operation, and refresh state as making every request equivalent to central session lookup. Removed the unrelated CVE-2015-9256 attribution rather than substituting an ID for a different failure. Distinguished ID token from API access token and token expiry from guaranteed one-time consumption.

mathematics.note: No mathematical formulas or quantitative derivations. The fifteen-minute lifetime is explicitly illustrative, not a normative requirement or measured security bound.

code.note: No executable authentication or token-verifier example is present. The three Mermaid flow descriptions were read semantically and their 8/6/6 directed edges matched with the source; local HTML contains them. No claims of penetration testing, library conformance, live authentication checks or benchmark results.

links.note: Matched all nine primary-reference URLs to the source, with actual reading scope and inaccessible-CVE-browser fallback recorded in batch-011-source-audit.json and source notes. Verified matching-language XSS/CSRF internal target and eyecatch. Checked both local HTML bodies, updated markers and removal of the wrong CVE; twelve-bundle Hugo, multilingual 830 pages and HTTPS 1,532 HTML/41 XML passed. Publication pending.
